name: WisdomTree Government Money Market Digital Fund
oneLiner: WTGXX is WisdomTree's SEC-registered '40 Act government money market fund tokenized at a stable $1 NAV, with reserves in Treasuries, repos, and cash.
collateral: Short-term U.S. Treasury bills, Treasury floating-rate notes, and tri-party repurchase agreements held by the WisdomTree Treasury Money Market Digital Fund (renamed from WisdomTree Government Money Market Digital Fund on 2025-11-01); a Rule 2a-7 '40 Act-registered money market fund managed by WisdomTree Digital Management with Voya Investment Management as sub-adviser, recorded natively on-chain via the WisdomTree Connect platform
pegMechanism: $1.00 stable NAV money market share; SEC-approved 24/7 dealer trading at fixed $1 intraday (Feb 2026); primary subscription and redemption are gated to WisdomTree Connect users with USDC dealer settlement and USD-wire alternatives

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: WisdomTree acts as transfer agent for WTGXX with permissioned token transfers restricted to WisdomTree Connect-onboarded holders, giving the issuer freeze and burn authority over WTGXX balances.

mintAuthority.summary: WTGXX token source restricts minting, burning, pause, freeze, and batch mint to REGISTRAR_ROLE. Ethereum role logs resolve one registrar EOA and one default-admin EOA.

controls.label: WTGXX Ethereum REGISTRAR_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: getImplementation() returned 0xC2A8ca84BC363605c36757f9409b214b6ee710c9. Sourcify ERC20ControlledStandard.sol shows mint and batchMint are onlyRole(REGISTRAR_ROLE); role events resolve this no-code account as REGISTRAR_ROLE holder.

controls.label: WTGXX default admin
controls.evidence: Role events resolve this no-code account as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Safe Transaction Service did not identify a Safe.

review.evidence: WisdomTree materials describe issuer-operated fund share issuance; verified Ethereum source and role reconstruction identify REGISTRAR_ROLE mint authority plus the default admin for the WTGXX token.
unresolvedQuestions: Reconstruct role holders on Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Optimism, and Plume before treating WTGXX as fully reviewed across all deployments.
Review Stellar issuer controls and signer policy.
Confirm custody or operational policy for the Ethereum registrar and default-admin EOAs.

notices.title: Multi-chain fund with limited on-chain telemetry
notices.message: WTGXX is the digital share token of WisdomTree's '40 Act government money market fund, deployed across Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Plume, and Stellar via WisdomTree Connect. Pharos tracks the verified contract set; live reserves use Chainlink's WTGXX NAV feed for score-grade reserve freshness.
